key_insight: SegWithU converts model uncertainty into a single-pass "perturbation energy" signal by adding a lightweight post-hoc head to a frozen segmentation backbone, enabling accurate risk-aware segmentation without repeated inference.
problem_solved: Provides reliable failure ranking and uncertainty maps for medical image segmentation while avoiding expensive multi-pass or restrictive feature-space assumptions, making uncertainty estimation practical for clinical workflows.
method: Post-hoc plug-in: attach a lightweight uncertainty head to a frozen, pretrained segmentation backbone (no re-training of main model required).
Uncertainty-as-energy: compute a perturbation-energy score from the head's outputs that correlates with segmentation failure risk in a single forward pass.
Efficient, backbone-agnostic design: produces calibrated uncertainty maps and risk rankings with minimal compute overhead, compatible with existing segmentation models.
impact: Delivers efficient, single-forward-pass uncertainty estimation that improves failure detection and triage in clinical pipelines, enabling safer deployment of automated segmentation without large latency or compute costs.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: frozen segmentation backbone + lightweight uncertainty head producing segmentation and perturbation-energy uncertainty map.
Heatmap overlay: example image with predicted segmentation and corresponding uncertainty/energy map highlighting likely failure regions.
Risk-coverage/reliability plot: showing improved failure-ranking or calibration compared to single-pass baselines and multi-pass methods.
Workflow icon strip: integration into clinical pipeline with low latency (single-pass) and downstream decision/triage steps.
paper_title: SegWithU: Uncertainty as Perturbation Energy for Single-Forward-Pass Risk-Aware Medical Image Segmentation
paper_authors: Tianhao Fu, Austin Wang, Charles Chen, Roby Aldave-Garza, Yucheng Chen
